name: lunar-trnrl v1.0
description: Code, results and figures for the paper "Where Does Learned Guidance Help? A Real-Terrain Lunar Landing Benchmark" (Nimesh Chauhan). The package contains an open 3-DoF lunar powered-descent benchmark on LOLA polar terrain (Site 04, Site 23, Haworth), with a 9-state navigation filter in the loop (IMU, Doppler, terrain-aided altimeter, terrain-relative navigation fixes). It includes the baseline guidance, residual PPO and a decision-layer policy, the scripts that run every experiment in the paper, the result files behind all tables and figures, and the research log. Terrain data are not included; see data/README.md for the public NASA PGDA download links. Realism-layer parameters (map registration offset, correlated map error, camera field of view) are assumptions, not instrument values.
